candidates.requirement: Exercise the changed gamma lookup behavior by decoding a valid PNG with a gAMA chunk and SPNG_DECODE_USE_GAMA enabled.
candidates.target_route: Supply a valid 1×1 RGBA PNG with a four-byte gAMA chunk before IDAT, then call spng_decode_image with SPNG_DECODE_USE_TRNS | SPNG_DECODE_USE_GAMA.
candidates.failure_condition: The fixed harness passes only SPNG_DECODE_USE_TRNS (1); the gamma guard requires SPNG_DECODE_USE_GAMA (2). No input bytes can change that call argument.
candidates.alternative_paths: The entry makes one decode call with a fixed flag. Ancillary parsing can set stored_gama, but neither that state nor the RGBA8 default enables the separate gamma flag.
